landing.quick.title: Start in 3 steps
landing.quick.lead: Use the desktop app and one master password to open a device password box. Sign in with an account for the cloud version.
landing.quick.setup.title: Check the setup guide
landing.quick.setup.body: Check the user guide for the differences between device and cloud storage and the supported setup methods.
landing.quick.create.title: Create a password box
landing.quick.create.body: For the device version, choose a file location and master password, then select Create. The recovery kit alone cannot currently restore access. Keep your master password and a backup of the file safe.
landing.quick.add.title: Add login details
landing.quick.add.body: Open the password box and add a site name, URL, username and password to get started.
landing.quick.example:
1. Open the desktop app
2. Choose a file location (e.g. Documents/mypasswords.pbox)
3. Set a master password and select Create
4. Add login details and use search and password generation
landing.features.title: Features and conditions
landing.features.lead: Tools for managing everyday login details without specialist IT knowledge.
landing.features.box.title: Password box
landing.features.box.body: Open and close a device password box with one master password.
landing.features.crypto.title: Device encryption
landing.features.crypto.body: Device .pbox files are encrypted on your device. When you use the cloud, item contents are also sent to the server, which can read them.
landing.features.generate.title: Password generation
landing.features.generate.body: Generate a password while adding login details.
landing.features.search.title: Find login details
landing.features.search.body: Search login details by site name, URL or username.
landing.features.manage.title: Manage login details
landing.features.manage.body: Add, view, edit and delete titles, URLs, usernames, passwords and notes.
landing.features.backup.title: Backup and recovery
landing.features.backup.body: Keep a copy of the device .pbox file and your master password safe. The recovery kit alone cannot currently open the file.
landing.features.desktop.title: Desktop app
landing.features.desktop.body: An app for opening files on your device and storing and editing login details.
landing.features.share.title: Sharing
landing.features.share.body: Invite team members and share through the web app. Identity checks and cloud encryption are being improved and are still under validation before sale.
landing.migration.title: Import supported formats
landing.migration.lead: Import 1Password-format CSV in the web and desktop apps. 1PUX import is also supported in the web app and desktop cloud connection. Other vendors' proprietary formats are not supported. Import files contain secrets, so handle them safely after import.
landing.migration.import: Check the imported items in your password box
landing.compare.title: Before using PassShare
landing.compare.lead: Device encryption and cloud storage work differently. The cloud server handles item contents. Check other providers' official plan descriptions for their capabilities and conditions.
landing.compare.box.check: How opening a box differs from account sign-in
landing.compare.crypto.value: Encrypted on the device; the cloud server can read contents

cloud.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. The encryption component checks the password.

cloud.recovery: Resetting the login password does not recover encrypted items. Recovery requires a backup file and code stored beforehand.
cloud.crudPending: This screen supports setup and opening only. Viewing, adding, editing, and deleting encrypted items are not available yet.
cloud.opened: The password box is open on this device.
cloud.pending: A previous setup may have been saved. Enter the same encryption password to check and retry that setup.
cloud.mismatch: The passwords do not match. Enter both again.
cloud.unavailable: Encryption setup is unavailable. Return to the password box list or try again later.
cloud.ownerOnly: Only the owner can set up or open this encrypted password box here.
cloud.notEmpty: Encryption setup requires an empty password box. Moving existing items is not available yet.
cloud.conflict: The saved setup could not be confirmed. Return to this password box on the same browser and account, then retry with the original encryption password.
cloud.failed: The password box could not be opened or setup confirmed. Check your encryption password and connection, then try again. If setup was interrupted, use the original encryption password.
cloud.logoutFailed: Sign-out could not be confirmed. The password box has been locked on this device. Try signing out again.
cloudRecovery.backupLead: Keep a backup file and a recovery code separately in case you forget the encryption password.
cloudRecovery.codeNote: The code is never sent to the server. Create new recovery materials after replacing the box key.
cloudRecovery.separateStored: I stored the file and code separately.
cloudRecovery.backupFailed: Recovery materials could not be created. If another item operation is running, wait for it to finish and try again.
cloudRecovery.title: Recover encryption password
cloudRecovery.fileNote: Select the JSON backup file (up to 4096 bytes). The file must not contain the recovery code.
cloudRecovery.separate: Login recovery and recovery of encrypted items are separate. Only the login password and sealed key bundle are sent to the server.
cloudRecovery.verifyNote: Completion is confirmed only after reopening the saved key and decrypting all current items.
cloudRecovery.cancelNote: Cancel stops requests where possible. A write already sent may still be saved. Reopen this form to check the same prepared save; leaving, locking or changing accounts clears it from memory.
cloudRecovery.prepared: The prepared sealed key bundle is held in memory. A retry uses the same bundle.
cloudRecovery.preparedPassword: Enter the new encryption password used for this prepared save again. Checking does not create a new bundle.
cloudRecovery.retryNote: The previous bundle is still stored. Use “Retry the same save” to send the prepared bundle again.
cloudRecovery.fileInvalid: Choose a nonempty JSON backup file no larger than 4096 bytes.
cloudRecovery.failed: Recovery could not be verified. Check the backup file, code, new password and connection. No success has been confirmed.
cloudRecovery.verifyFailed: The bundle was saved, but reopening and decrypting all items could not be confirmed. Enter the same new password and check the saved result.
cloudRecovery.unknown: The save result is unknown. Check the saved result before retrying; do not create new recovery materials.
cloudRecovery.rejected: The save was rejected. Check the login password and any retry limit, then check the saved result.
cloudRecovery.conflict: The stored version changed. The existing bundle was kept. Restart recovery using the current state.
cloudRecovery.complete: Recovery was saved and all current items were decrypted with the new password. Open the box normally with that password.
